items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Ah, yes, it was a place there called Sally Smith Hearts.

ctx.x: Ah, Lee, who was in your hometown there in Henderson, weren't there? Some red light districts. I know they had, didn't they have a place called Audubon, Sally Smith Heart?
Ah, yes, it was a place there called Sally Smith Hearts. It was out in Audubon, in the East End. It was quite a notorious place and quite an exclusive place, you know.
Ah, didn't, did they have a player piano?
